scope: Exact H16 canonical-only ordered finalization replay; source inspection only, active RED1 untouched
assumptions: Original persisted first-flat RAW_POSITION and EXIT_REQUESTED projection are CONSISTENT actual_quantity0; latest raw anchor is not newer than this flat anchor.
Canonical original stop CANCELED and all final request/result/fill facts already durable, no UNKNOWN/DEGRADED/extra lineage/conflict; actual canonical funding already durable.

Baseline current old binding is valid for old projection but its execution snapshot omits newly durable terminal stop fact. Baseline exact status/reasons are REINTERPRETATION_REQUIRED/[E5_EXECUTION_REINTERPRETATION_REQUIRED].
CLOSED/new binding/TradeResult are exact saved immutable outbox effects built by canonical E5 owners. No concurrent order/fill/raw/funding/lifecycle mutation or missing reference graph.

states.history_delta: lifecycle_history appends exact saved CLOSED; lifecycle_execution_bindings unchanged
states.subtlety: Old binding is retained in history but is not current and is not checked for the new current projection; E5_EXECUTION_REINTERPRETATION_REQUIRED disappears, not carried forward.

states.history_delta: lifecycle_history appends exact CLOSED; lifecycle_execution_bindings appends exact new binding
states.subtlety: Full new binding matches actual complete snapshot including all original stop observations, so no reinterpretation reason. Old historical binding remains immutable even though stale versus current global execution snapshot.

READY conditional on exact referenced plan/actions/requests/fills/funding graph. This state before publication receipt may be replayed idempotently, then exact saved publication receipt marked. No provider permission is inferred.

compare_to_original_baseline.ordering: First independently recognize exact prefix by exact object IDs+payload_json/hash, correct ordering/presence, exact status+reason tuple and unchanged other facts. Only then compare a canonical-facts normalization against saved original baseline. Normalized view is comparison-only; never persist or present it as actual recovery/authority.

fields_to_remove_or_restore.operation: Remove ONLY exact saved CLOSED appended terminal element; require rest equals baseline in order. A foreign successor, duplicate/replaced row, wrong revision/predecessor or changed payload denies.
For prefix>=1 restore the exact baseline original EXIT_REQUESTED object in comparison view; actual current must first equal saved CLOSED. Before prefix1 it must equal baseline.
For prefix>=2 remove ONLY exact saved new binding; preserve ALL old bindings including original stale one in exact order. Prefix1 has no new binding to remove.

For prefix1 actual is None; prefix>=2 actual is saved new binding. Restore exact baseline old binding for comparison, retrieved by original projection linkage; do not choose last old record without exact identity.
For prefix3 require exact saved TradeResult then remove it in comparison view (baseline None); otherwise actual must be None.

Derived current-view diagnostics naturally change with owned prefixes. Compare via exact four-state table first; exclude only these derived fields from baseline fact comparison, or explicitly restore saved baseline diagnostics in private comparison object. Never remove arbitrary reasons or force READY.

compare_to_original_baseline.not_owned_effects: Original stop CANCELED/latest result and all historical results were already in baseline, so MUST NOT be stripped. Canonical funding was already in baseline, so MUST NOT be stripped or silently expanded.

writer_and_anchor_subtleties: persist_position_projection inserts lifecycle projection + updates current index, not RAW_POSITION. Exact replay existing ID/same bytes returns idempotently even if current index has advanced; therefore replay must independently refuse any unrelated later current projection instead of relying solely on writer success. Ref src/storage/_paper_runtime.py:251-269,456-493.

Binding writer requires projection already durable, validates shape/linkage and immutable one-binding-per-projection. It does not repair or overwrite old binding. Current snapshot freshness is checked by recover, so final all-effects recovery must actually match. Ref src/storage/_lifecycle_execution_binding.py:345-423,627-642.

Execution snapshot recomputes ALL position-linked result observations sorted by observed_at/hash plus fills, not merely current_order_results or observations before original flat clock. Later CANCELED may be included while broker flat anchor remains unchanged. Ref src/storage/_lifecycle_execution_binding.py:248-342.

Raw latest anchor newer than current projection yields E5_REATTESTATION_REQUIRED independently of execution reinterpretation; that is an additional fact change, not an owned finalization effect. Do not normalize it away. Ref src/storage/_paper_runtime.py:993-1014.

E5 closed builder requires actual TradeResultBuildOutcome authorizing POSITION_CLOSED/CLOSED, exact zero CONSISTENT raw source, result closed_at/flat_position_observed_at==raw broker anchor, nonregression and identical broker facts at equal time. A later local lifecycle_interpreted_at is not a new raw observation. Ref src/position/lifecycle_projection.py:573-648.

TradeResult facade validates actual reference graph before writer; durable funding interval/status/cost checks apply. Reference-remediation can produce CONFLICT/INCOMPLETE for actual invalid graph. These reasons are not permitted own-prefix noise. Ref src/storage/runtime.py:191-204; _traderesult_reference_remediation.py:120-173; _paper_runtime.py:801-829.
unknowns: No actual native/source execution occurred here. The four exact status/reason tuples are static consequences under stated clean baseline assumptions, not observed results.

No classification for arbitrary intermediate graphs, newer raw observations, conflicting/replaced IDs, extra funding/results or concurrently added claims is proposed. Such states require rejection/explicit reconciliation, not broader status allowlists.
